tagline: Global leader in adhesive technologies and consumer brands with strong market positions in industrial and consumer applications
hero_kpi_rationale: Henkel's adjusted EBIT margin of 15.5% in the first half of 2025 demonstrates solid operational profitability and cost management efficiency despite challenging market conditions and declining nominal sales

kpis.name: Sales H1 2025
kpis.explanation: Total group sales revenue for the first six months of 2025, reflecting nominal sales development across Adhesive Technologies and Consumer Brands segments.
kpis.description: Henkel achieved group sales of 10,402 million euros in H1 2025, down 3.8% from 10,813 million euros in H1 2024. Organic sales growth was -0.1%, with Adhesive Technologies at +1.2% and Consumer Brands at -1.6%.
kpis.signal: Sales decline driven by foreign exchange effects (-2.8%) and portfolio divestments (-0.9%), with organic growth flat at -0.1%

kpis.name: Adjusted EBIT Margin H1 2025
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit margin (adjusted EBIT margin) demonstrates operational efficiency and profitability after excluding one-time expenses, restructuring costs, and other adjustments.
kpis.description: Adjusted return on sales (adjusted EBIT margin) reached 15.5% in H1 2025, up 0.6 percentage points from 14.9% in H1 2024. Adhesive Technologies achieved 17.2% and Consumer Brands 15.3%.
kpis.signal: Strong operational profitability with adjusted EBIT margin expanding by 60 basis points year-over-year despite challenging market conditions

kpis.name: Adjusted EBIT H1 2025
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit excluding one-time expenses, income adjustments, and restructuring costs to show underlying operational performance.
kpis.description: Adjusted operating profit (adjusted EBIT) was 1,614 million euros in H1 2025 compared to 1,610 million euros in H1 2024, representing marginal growth of 0.2%.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EBIT essentially flat year-over-year, indicating stable underlying operational performance despite headwinds from currency and portfolio changes

kpis.name: Net Income H1 2025
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to shareholders of Henkel AG & Co. KGaA for the first half of 2025, reflecting total profitability after all expenses, taxes, and non-controlling interests.
kpis.description: Net income attributable to shareholders reached 1,110 million euros in H1 2025, up 7.9% from 1,029 million euros in H1 2024.
kpis.signal: Net income growth of 7.9% demonstrates improving bottom-line profitability despite flat organic sales, benefiting from improved operational efficiency and financial management

kpis.name: Adjusted EPS H1 2025
kpis.explanation: Adjusted earnings per preferred share excluding one-time expenses and restructuring costs, showing underlying per-share profitability. Development at constant exchange rates shows +5.0%.
kpis.description: Adjusted earnings per preferred share was 2.81 euros in H1 2025 compared to 2.78 euros in H1 2024, representing growth of 1.1%. At constant exchange rates, growth reached 5.0%.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EPS growth of 5.0% at constant exchange rates demonstrates underlying earnings strength, with reported growth of 1.1% impacted by currency headwinds

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 32.53 billion euros in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 3.71 billion euros in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of 2.71 billion euros in the latest year

risks.title: Raw material commodity price dependency
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned in 2025 outlook (expected increase of 1-2.5% in direct material prices). Moderate but quantified language. Stable but recurring trend. Significant weight for chemical/adhesive company.

risks.title: Foreign exchange volatility and translation impacts
risks.score_rationale: Translation effect of foreign currencies expected negative (low to mid single-digit %) in 2025. Explicit language in outlook. Trend up (deterioration vs 2024: neutral to low negative single-digit). High weight for multinational group (38% sales Europe, 27% North America, 16% Asia-Pacific).

risks.title: Competitive intensity and pricing pressure in Consumer Brands
risks.score_rationale: Consumer Brands shows weak organic growth (-1.6% H1 2025, -3.7% adjusted for currency) and EBIT margin 14.8% vs 16.6% for Adhesive Technologies. 2025 outlook reduced (0.5-1.5% vs 1.0-3.0% previously). Implicit language but clear quantified data. Trend up (outlook deterioration).

risks.title: Goodwill and intangible asset impairment risk
risks.score_rationale: Goodwill represents 42.2% of total assets (13.8 billion euros at 6/30/2025), intangible assets 10.5% (3.4 billion euros). Impairments H1 2025: 4 million euros (vs 56 million euros H1 2024, decrease). Neutral language but massive structural exposure. Trend down (reduced impairments). High weight for category given active M&A group.

risks.title: Organic growth slowdown and guidance revisions
risks.score_rationale: Organic growth H1 2025: -0.1% (vs +0.9% Q2 2025). 2025 outlook revised downward: 1.0-2.0% (vs 1.5-3.5% previously). Explicit and quantified language. Trend up (deterioration). High weight: growth is central strategic KPI.

risks.title: Latin America geographical exposure and macroeconomic volatility
risks.score_rationale: Latin America: -13.2% sales H1 2025 vs H1 2024 (750 million euros, 7% of group). Organic decline +0.4% but nominal very negative. Implicit language (quantified data). Trend up (deterioration). Moderate weight (7% sales) but high volatility.

risks.title: Acquisition dependency for growth and integration execution
risks.score_rationale: Acquisitions expected with low single-digit negative impact on nominal growth in 2025. Goodwill 42.2% of assets. Non-recurring additions H1 2025: 405 million euros (vs 1,745 million euros H1 2024, decrease post-2024 acquisitions). Moderate language. Stable trend. Moderate weight but implicit integration risk.

risks.title: Ongoing restructuring and transformation costs
risks.score_rationale: Restructuring expenses H1 2025: 46 million euros (vs 110 million euros H1 2024). 2025 outlook: 150-200 million euros (vs 200-250 million euros previously). Explicit and quantified language. Trend down (cost reduction). Moderate weight but recurring and structural.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the H1 2025 half-year financial report. The organization focuses on traditional adhesive technologies, consumer brands, and operational efficiency improvements.
evidence: No references to AI, machine learning, automation, digital transformation, or related emerging technologies in the interim management report or financial statements
